Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1881. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary, then INNER JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation equals '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
